paragraphs.en: Can a small group of drones ( (无人机) ) {guarantee} the {safety} and {reliability} of {railways} and, at the same time, help railway {operators} save {billions} of {euros} each year? That is the very likely future of applying today's “eyes in the sky” technology to make sure that more than one million kilometers of {rail} tracks and infrastructure ( (基础设施) ) {worldwide} are safe for trains 24/7.
paragraphs.cn: 一小群无人机能否在 <u> 保障铁路安全可靠 </u> 的同时，还能帮助铁路 <u> 运营商 </u> 每年节省数 <u> 十亿欧元 </u> 呢？利用当今的“天眼”技术，确保 <u> 全球 </u> 100多万公里的 <u> 铁路 </u> 轨道和基础设施全天候安全运行，这很可能会成为未来的现实。

paragraphs.en: Drones are already being used to examine {high-tension} {electrical} lines.They could do precisely the same thing to {inspect} railway lines and other vital aspects of rail infrastructure, such as the correct position of railway tracks and the functioning of switching points.The more {regularly} they can be inspected, the more railway safety, reliability and on-time performance will be improved.Costs would be cut and {operations} would be more efficient across the board.
paragraphs.cn: 无人机已经被用于检查 <u> 高压电 </u> 线。在 <u> 检查 </u> 铁路线路和基础设施的其他关键部分（如铁轨的位置是否正确、道岔的状态是否良好）时，无人机也能发挥同样的作用。 <u> 定期 </u> 检查越频繁，铁路的安全性、可靠性和准点率就会越高。成本会降低， <u> 运营 </u> 效率也会全面提高。

paragraphs.en: That includes huge {savings} in {maintenance} costs and better {protection} of railway {personnel's} safety.It is {calculated} that European railways alone spend over 50 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff to inspect and {repair} the rail infrastructure.That can be dangerous work, especially in {deserts} and {snowy} mountainous regions, which could be avoided with drones {assisting} the {crews’} efforts.
paragraphs.cn: 这其中包括 <u> 节省 </u> 大量 <u> 维护 </u> 成本，以及更好地 <u> 保护 </u> 铁路工作 <u> 人员 </u> 的安全。据 <u> 计算 </u> ，仅欧洲的铁路每年用于维护的花费就高达500多亿欧元，其中包括派遣维护人员检查和 <u> 修理 </u> 铁路基础设施。这可能是一项危险的工作，尤其是在 <u> 沙漠 </u> 和 <u> 雪 </u> 山地区，而有了无人机 <u> 协助工作人员 </u> ，就可以避免这些危险。

paragraphs.en: Railway {officials} are recognizing the importance of drones in {defense} against potential accidents.By using the latest technologies, drones could detect {faults} in the rail or switches, before they cause any safety problems.For example, drones could provide real-time ( (实时的) ) {alerts} to approaching trains, when {kangaroos} or other wildlife wander onto the tracks in Australia.In regions with active {volcanoes} , drones can monitor their activities near railway lines, ensuring that {villages} and rail services are safe in case they {erupt} .
paragraphs.cn: 铁路部门的 <u> 官员 </u> 正在认识到无人机在 <u> 防范 </u> 潜在事故方面的重要性。借助最新技术，无人机可以检测铁轨或 <u> 道岔 </u> 的 <u> 故障 </u> ，以免其导致安全问题。例如，在澳大利亚，当 <u> 袋鼠 </u> 或其他野生动物闯入铁轨时，无人机可以向驶来的列车发出实时 <u> 警报 </u> 。在有活火山的地区，无人机可以监控铁路沿线附近的 <u> 火山 </u> 活动，在火山 <u> 爆发 </u> 时确保周边 <u> 村庄 </u> 和铁路服务的安全。

paragraphs.en: {Engineers} are now working on a new concept: the rail drones of the future.They will be moving on the track ahead of the train, and programmed to operate {autonomously} .Tiny drones with {advanced} sensors and AI travelling ahead of the train could guide it like a {co-pilot} .With their ability to see ahead, they could signal any problem, so that fast-moving trains would be able to {react} in time.In case of emergencies, drones could also assist in working with {ambulance} services.Additionally, the huge {volume} of data collected by drones can be analyzed to predict repair needs, benefiting both the repair {division} and {insurance} providers.As for the legal aspects, {consultation} with {lawyers} would be required to address the challenges of drone use.
paragraphs.cn: 目前， <u> 工程师 </u> 们正在研究一种新概念——未来铁路无人机。它们将在列车前方的轨道上空移动，并被 <u> 设定 </u> 为 <u> 自动 </u> 运行。微型无人机配备了 <u> 先进的 </u> 传感器和人工智能，当它们在列车前方飞行时，可以像 <u> 副驾驶员 </u> 一样引导列车行进。凭借观察前方的能力，无人机可以进行异常预警，从而让高速行驶的列车及时 <u> 作出反应 </u> 。在紧急情况下，无人机还能协助 <u> 救护车 </u> 服务。此外，无人机收集到的大 <u> 量 </u> 数据可以进行分析，以预测维修需求，这对维修 <u> 部门 </u> 和 <u> 保险 </u> 公司都有好处。至于法律方面的问题，则需要 <u> 咨询律师 </u> ，以应对无人机使用带来的挑战。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
